source.title: Opening and closing of Oxalis leaves in response to light stimuli

quote: Fully folded leaves (prepared by a 90-minute dark period) opened in response to dim blue light
note: Paper names O. corymbosa DC. (O. martiana Zucc.); retained that source name without assuming synonymy to a focal species. Blue at 0.13 μmol m−2 s−1 induced opening, red at 5.6 μmol m−2 s−1 did not; blue LED peak 470 nm and red 670 nm gave the same result. Complete repository PDF read.

value: leaves reopen faster under stronger light; leaf unfolding at night depends on irradiance, whereas flowers remain closed
conditions: Growth chamber; morning and evening illumination; about 20°C
